verdict.rationale: Hightouch clearly supports computed traits: models can be built with SQL, dbt, or a visual builder and used directly in audience/journey targeting via Customer Studio, and Identity Resolution can produce a golden-record profile view. However, there is no evidence of a native predictive-scoring capability (LTV, churn, purchase propensity) computed by Hightouch itself — the closest feature, 'AI Decisioning,' is a reinforcement-learning message/channel/timing optimizer, not a per-profile predictive score usable as an audience filter attribute. Missing for 10: documentation of built-in ML models producing LTV/churn/propensity scores stored as profile attributes, and evidence these specific score types are selectable in audience-builder filters.
